Subject: Meridian call recap & proposed action owners (post-call)

Hi Elaine (and procurement),

Thanks for the productive conversation — below is a short recap, confirmed constraints, and proposed owners to keep momentum. Please flag anything I mis-stated.

Summary of pain & goals (as stated):
- Regulatory driver: Meridian has a pilot with a state-regulated payer requiring that certain patient-identifiable processing remain in an air-gapped environment or on-prem for auditability.
- Risk: Current cloud-hosted third-party models could trigger cross-border or third-party data sharing concerns for a subset of PHI.
- Goal: Run inference for the payer pilot with parity to hosted model behavior while guaranteeing data residency and attestation controls.

Technical constraints and notes we confirmed:
- Air-gap requirement: A small set of inference workflows (token-grade PHI) must not egress to public internet or external multi-tenant clusters. Meridian prefers an on-prem appliance or a VPC-isolated deployment with a managed physical ingress.
- VPC peering: Customer requires explicit VPC peering with no NAT egress for the pilot; only specific CIDR ranges allowed (Meridian will provide ranges).
- Firewall & egress: Outbound connections from the inference environment must be blocked except to Redwood's approved update endpoints (list to be scoped).
- Key management: Keys must be customer-controlled (KMS/HSM) and logs retained for 2 years for audit.
- Data flows: Pre-processing will occur in Meridian's environment; only tokenized batched requests to Redwood's runtime accepted. No persistent backups of PII allowed on Redwood-managed storage for pilot.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Meridian: share CIDR ranges and the security questionnaire answers for the pilot scope (Elaine / procurement) — due: 2028-07-05.
- Redwood (Jonas): perform quick feasibility check on providing an isolated VPC deployment with disabled outbound NAT and customer KMS integration; provide a short gap list — due: 2028-07-07.
- Redwood (Laura): draft a short operational runbook for pilot (network steps, deployment checklist, rollback/fallback) and attach a sketch of the proposed VPC topology (see attachment) — due: 2028-07-09.
- Priyom: coordinate document links, draft SOW/estimate ballpark for pilot (not contract) and schedule a technical deep-dive next week — due: 2028-07-08.

Attachments included: meridian_vpc_sketch.png (basic topology), meridian-data-flow.xlsx (data classification & examples).

Open questions we left on the call:
1) Does Meridian require hardware attestation (SGX/Tee) for model execution or is KMS + audit logs sufficient for phase 1?
2) Will the customer accept a Redwood-managed appliance in their colo (we discussed but didn't decide) or do they require a 100% customer-managed on-prem deploy?
3) Are there any procurement constraints (length of trial, service window) procurement team should state now?

Please reply with confirmations or edits. If the owners above look correct, we'll start the feasibility work and lock the deep-dive slot.

Thanks,
— Priyom
Priyom Das

Subject: Re: Meridian call recap & proposed action owners (post-call)

Priyom / team — thanks for the clear recap. All owners look correct from our side. A few clarifications and answers: 

- CIDR ranges: procurement@meridianhealth.com will send the secure spreadsheet with ranges and firewall rules by EOD 2028-07-05.
- Hardware attestation: for phase 1 we can accept customer-controlled KMS + detailed audit logs; SGX is a phase 2 ask if needed.
- Colo vs on-prem: Meridian is open to a vendor-managed appliance in our colo (we have a dedicated cage) if Redwood can guarantee no external egress and separate management plane.
- Procurement constraints: trial length should be 60 days; procurement will include commercial guardrails in the packet they send.

We'll expect the feasibility gaps from Jonas and the runbook from Laura. Also please include any Docs or readouts we can use for our security team to speed review (SOC2 report references, network endpoints list, KMS integration notes).

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform — Meridian Health
